content:
The holidays are often the best time to subscribe to streaming services at deep discounts, and that’s true again this year. Here are the best Black Friday deals that are already live for HBO Max, Peacock, Apple TV, and more.

HBO Max: $5.49/month with ads (normally $10.99)

HBO Max has a 50% off deal for its Basic with Ads plan only, but it lets you get the discounted price for a full 12 months.

Through November 30, HBO Max with ads is only $5.49/month. That’s big savings off the standard price of $10.99/month.

The lack of discount for ad-free plans is disappointing, but if you can live with ads, getting to keep the discounted HBO Max price for a full year is a great deal.

Apple TV: $6.99/month (normally $14.99)

Apple TV is offering over 50% off for its Black Friday deal, and you can lock in the discounted price for the next six months.

With the discount, Apple TV is only $6.99/month (down from $14.99) for new and returning subscribers. The offer is valid through November 30.

The streamer is currently airing hit crime thrillers Nocturne and 12 12 12, a new season of beloved comedy Stick, and is about to bring back a show from Ted Lasso and Shrinking’s creator. Looking further out, January will bring the streamer’s major new sci-fi series Neuromancer and a lot more.

Paramount+: $2.99/month (normally $13.99)

Paramount+ is offering the best possible savings per month, but with the shortest term length. Through November 30, you can subscribe to any Paramount+ monthly plan for only $2.99/month.

  • Paramount+ Premium: $2.99/month, down from $13.99/month
  • Paramount+ Essential: $2.99/month, down from $8.99/month

The only catch is that the deal is valid for just two months. So after two months, your monthly rate will go back to the standard pricing.

Peacock: $8.99/month with ads (normally $12.99)

Peacock is running a Black Friday deal, but it’s one of the weakest among streamers.

You can get Peacock Premium for $8.99/month for up to three months. This is their base plan with ads that includes Peacock Originals. It’s normally priced at $12.99/month.

If you’re an Apple TV subscriber, you’re better off simply adding Peacock on to your Apple TV subscription. It only costs $3/month to add Peacock through Apple, a much better deal overall.

Audible: $0.99/month plus $20 credit

Amazon isn’t offering a discount on Prime Video, likely because most subscribers get it through a broader Prime subscription. But the company does have a great deal available for Audible.

If you’re at all interested in audiobooks, Audible now lets you subscribe for $0.99/month for the first three months (down from $8.99) and also gives you a bonus $20 credit to spend on audiobooks.

Which discounted streaming services are you signing up for? Let us know in the comments.
